response.text:
I can do that, but I need a few clarifications and your confirmation before making any changes — I can’t continue working in the background or notify you later unless you authorize a real automation (Gmail/Calendar) now.

Please tell me:
1) Which sender? Give the email address or confirm you mean the sender of the message you’re currently looking at.  
2) Scope — do you want:
   - Only existing conversation threads from that sender archived now, or
   - Both existing threads archived and a Gmail filter created so future messages from that sender are automatically archived?
3) Notification method for “notify me tomorrow” — do you want:
   - An email sent to you tomorrow,
   - A calendar reminder/event tomorrow,
   - Or just a message here when you return? (I can’t deliver notifications later unless you let me create/send the email or calendar reminder now.)
4) Permission to perform changes: Do you authorize me to access your Gmail (and Calendar if you want a reminder) to create the filter, apply it to existing messages, and set the reminder? (I will only proceed after you confirm.)

If you prefer not to grant access, I can instead give step-by-step instructions you can run yourself to archive and set a reminder. Which would you like?
